status.note: Still pre-opening: the pizzeria's own site says 'Coming Soon to Hillman City' and August 2026 coverage reports the full restaurant isn't expected to open until 2027 despite a pop-up preview event.
Both the downtown and Greenwood locations show current hours and reviews updated as recently as September 2026 with no closure indication.
The wood-fired Latin-fusion food truck is still listed as active at its West Seattle spot with current hours and reviews updated as recently as August 2026.

The pizzeria's own site confirms it has consolidated to a single operating Seattle location in Portage Bay at 2919 Fuhrman Ave E after closing its Auburn spot; the previously-known Delridge Way address is outdated.
The Ballard Detroit-style pizzeria shows current hours and reviews updated as recently as July 2026 with no closure indication.
The chain's own locations page lists 15 active Seattle locations open for pickup, with only one Eastside location (Kirkland - Bridle Trails) temporarily closed for a remodel through early November.
